scope: One freshly generated seed-45 common ALNS incumbent, two sequential matched-input matched-incumbent 660s live-CG budget profiles; not two independently randomized cold starts or stability evidence.
hypothesis: With live CG in both profiles, shifting weak subset and conditional re-pricing budget to original cover generation may strengthen the total same-budget bound; this joint budget profile does not identify an individual parameter effect.
default: Existing defaults preserved; both profiles opt-in resume
required_checks: Frozen identical sources and original inputs
Common fresh initial charged to each 660s pipeline
Same seed and total budget; joint profile effect only
Complete-domain pricing matrix and dual repair
Full E1 and conditional master projection
Sequential heavy jobs; uncontrolled machine load recorded
decision: One-seed joint profile improved LB/GAP but worsened UB slightly. Defaults unchanged; 5 percent target unmet.
timing_limitation: Identical common initial and requested primal budget; timed second route-pool runs ended at different incumbents. Load and stage incumbents recorded. Whole-profile observation only.
